title: First controller is player 2, second is player 1
why: His order (2026-10-18): right now if both games are fullscreened, my controller controls both screens at the same time, that is not the intent -- first controller plugged in always controls p2 only, second controller plugged in always controls p1 only. Entering the arcade put player 1 on controller 1 and player 2 on controller 2, and a window whose controller was not plugged in fell to the first free one before the other window pick reached it, so one controller was read by both windows. The arcade now leaves both windows on the order the controllers were plugged in (first is player 2, second is player 1, one alone is player 2), a controller state handed over names the side it is for and the other window refuses one meant for its partner, and a controller pick kept under the old order is cleared once.
now: The first controller switched on is now player 2 only, the second is player 1 only, and one controller alone goes to player 2. A window never plays the controller of the other player.
